tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is now training its frontier artificial intelligence models with no internet access, reported by The Verge.
Congress introduces a bipartisan bill that would task NIST with developing artificial intelligence cyber defense standards to protect U.S. artificial intelligence models and critical infrastructure, confirmed by MeriTalk.
The U.S. proposes unemployment insurance reforms to address artificial intelligence driven job disruptions and expand benefits to protect workers, confirmed by Equitable Growth.
Texas sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over product safety, reported by Politico.
Marie Haynes turns 600 OKF files into paid SEO audits using Gemini 4 Argon, reported by PPC Land.
Free every hour.
